title: dataset-level gate: one decision per dataset from S3_D on all DEV devices
status: in force from the commit that adds this file (committed alone, before any I19-1 code or S3_D value)
test_locked: IHP SG13G2 TEST 10 DUTs x 233/300/343/398 K
TU Delft 40 nm TEST 24 x 4.13/295.0 K

statistic.name: S3_D
statistic.definition: mean over DEV records r of the dataset of ln(RRMS(r, I_start*exp(g_{-k(r)})) / RRMS(r, I_start)); g_{-k(r)} = gated arm's recipe, seed 0, 500 steps, trained on the training set of the leave-one-group-out fold holding out k(r) (all DEV records outside k(r); IHP: same class outside k(r)), record load order, applied post hoc; nanmean
statistic.lambda_g_v2: lambda*_f of the outer fold that holds out k(r) (I15-2 / I17-2 inner / I18-2 lambda_star)

decision.sensitivity_source: zero crossing of I7-1 OLS y = -0.0298 + 1.214 S3 on the 20 simulated datasets
decision.threshold_reason: direct meaning (post-hoc inner gain); same threshold as I8-2 G and I18-1; OLS crossing fitted to a different statistic (fold-mean S3) and v1 recipe only

part_R.label: retrospective (DEV outcomes and I8-2 G values known)
part_R.rows: I18-1 rows; gated_D = correction row if S3_D < 0 else C0_refit row
part_R.gmr: i3_2_bias.paired_ratio, 10000 resamples, seed 0, percentile 95% CI; device; 7-group cluster for TU Delft
part_R.R1: GMR(gated_D, C0_refit) point value <= 1 on each of the 9 datasets
part_R.R2: pooled exp(mean ln GMR(gated_D, C0_refit)) over 9 datasets < pooled exp(mean ln GMR(correction always, C0_refit)) (I18-1 0.958)
part_R.leakage: scored DEV devices' starting-card records enter S3_D; held-out refit rows do not

part_P.file: test_gate_decisions.json/.md, committed alone before any TEST evaluation and before the decide step
part_P.comparison: I8-2 committed TEST sign predictions (S3 sign, frozen S1_lodo rule); NIST: DEV P_c of I8-1 / I9-1 for reference
part_P.evaluation_at_TEST: decision correct iff it equals sign of TEST ln GMR(correction, C0_refit); not part of I19-1

part_C.C: sign accuracy (S3_D < 0) == (y_D < 0) on at least 19 of 20

outcome.supported: valid, Part R supported and Part C holds

validity.V1: Part R row counts 18/53/87/18x4/45x2, rows equal I18-1 rows
validity.V2: S3 code reproduces stored fold values: IHP 300 K v1 folds hv_nmos_W0p3_L0p5, lv_nmos_W0p15_L0p18 (I7-1); sky130 g v2 fold nmos_L0p15_W1p6 (I18-1); |diff| <= 1e-9
validity.V3: S3_D finite on every primary, v1 secondary and simulated dataset; one inner fit per inner group
validity.V5: every loaded record tag in DEV list and not in TEST list (NIST, IHP, TU Delft)

known_before_registration: I18-1 rows and GMRs; I8-2 G values (fold-mean S3) of every dataset (sky130 -0.175, NIST -0.108/-0.071, IHP +0.353/+0.254/+0.375/+0.395, TU Delft g v2 +0.018/+0.201; v1 -0.033/-0.041); I7-1 simulated y_D and fold-mean S3 (19/20 sign agreement)
